declarations.description:
The top of a page: where you are (a breadcrumb, or a parent link on narrow widths), what this is (your heading, a
leading visual, status badges, a description, metadata), what you can do (page actions) and where you can go next
(tabs), with an optional toolbar for search and filters. Write the heading yourself — usually an `<h1>` — in the
default slot; the page header styles it and never decides its level.

The layout follows its **own width**: below 600px the parent link replaces the breadcrumb, the leading visual hides
and the actions take their own row. The parent link is the `parent` slot, or is derived from the second-to-last item
of a slotted `c2-breadcrumb`.

Actions that do not fit fold into a "More actions" menu, those without `overflow-priority` first (from the end of the
row), then by ascending priority. The action marked `primary` never folds and is drawn last. Only actions a menu row
can reproduce fold: `c2-button`, `c2-icon-button`, `c2-link-button`, `<button>` and `<a href>` (a folded link stays a
link, a folded submit button submits its form); anything else, such as a `c2-split-button`, always stays. A page
header rendered on the server cannot fold (its declarative shadow root cannot assign slots by hand), so its actions
wrap instead.

With `sticky`, once the title has scrolled out a condensed bar stays at `--c2-page-header--sticky-top`, showing the
parent link, the title, a copy of the title badges and the primary action itself. Inside a `c2-app-shell` the offset
comes from the shell, so the bar sits under its header with no CSS.

members.name: sticky
members.description: Keep a condensed bar with the title and the primary action once the title has scrolled out of view.

members.name: parentHref
members.description: Overrides the target of the parent link derived from the breadcrumb.

members.name: parentLabel
members.description: Overrides the text of the parent link derived from the breadcrumb.

members.name: moreActionsLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the "More actions" button. Empty: "More actions" in the page language.

members.name: collected
members.description:
False for the first render, on the server and in the browser alike: a server renderer cannot see the light DOM, so
the first render shows every part and no derived content, which is also what hydration expects to find.

members.name: suffixCopies
members.description: `aria-hidden` copies of the title badges for the condensed bar, rebuilt only when the badges change.

members.name: condensed
members.description: Whether the condensed bar is showing.

members.name: foldedActions
members.description: The actions currently folded into "More actions".

members.name: manualSlots
members.description: False only when the shadow root came from declarative shadow DOM (server rendering), which is always in named mode.

members.name: collectChildren
members.description: Groups the light-DOM children by the slot they asked for; each slot is then assigned its group by hand.

members.name: observeActions
members.description:
Re-folds when an action's own width changes: a `c2-button` measured before its module loaded is a line of plain
text, and a label can change. An action leaving the row (folded, so unassigned) reports 0 and is ignored, so
folding does not trigger itself.

members.name: deriveParent
members.description: The parent link: the breadcrumb's second-to-last item, overridden by `parent-href` / `parent-label`.

members.name: stickyTop
members.description: The sticky offset as the stylesheet resolves it: the page header's own variable, else the enclosing shell's.

members.name: observeTitle
members.description:
Watches the title line against the area below `--c2-page-header--sticky-top`. The offset can change after the
observer was made (a `c2-app-shell` measures its header after both have rendered), so it is re-read on every
callback and resize, and the observer is rebuilt when it moved.

members.name: syncCondensedGeometry
members.description:
The host sticks with only its last `--c2-page-header__condensed--height` pixels in view, so it never leaves its
containing block; the primary action is shifted (not moved) into the bar, keeping its place, state and focus.

members.name: relativeBox
members.description: The element's layout box relative to the host, ignoring any transform on it.

events.name: condensed-change
events.description: A sticky page header's title scrolled out of view or back in. Does not bubble.

events.name: overflow-change
events.description: The set of actions folded into "More actions" changed. Does not bubble.
